listing.name: Rigel Security - Translation of Beta Version
listing.summary: Translation of in-development Rigel Security Mod Originally By Shenqiang (Aka. ChenLingShinSou)

description:
Translation of in-development Rigel Security Mod Originally By Shenqiang (Aka. ChenLingShinSou)

Translated by Myco and Miko

Dependencies:
Lazy Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0
Magic Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25868.0
Graphic Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=10982.0

Download:
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Rigel-Security/releases/download/v0.23/Rigel_Security.0.23.zip

A cross sector Conglomerate with its main focus on military services, including armed escort, mercenary, weapons trade. Their service are varied, and most faction within the sector have purchased military service from RigSec. While backed up by various capital ships, the fleet is mainly based on more economical and flexible cruisers and destroyers.

Currently Adds a faction with
13 Ships
15 Weapons
7LPC
11 Hullmods
2 Star Systems

Known Incompatibility: Advanced Gunnery AI is it compatible with some weapon in this mod due to those having custom AI of their own
